biotools.summary: Standard methods for analysis of mutation data following error- corrected sequencing (ECS) for the purpose of mutagencity assessment. Functions include importing the mutation lists provided by a variant caller, and a set of analytical tools for statistical testing and visualization of mutation data; comparison to COSMIC and/or germline signatures; etc.
